FROM        OS AS os INNER JOIN
                  OS_Servicos_Auto AS serv ON os.COD_OS = serv.cod_os
WHERE     (MONTH(os.DATA_ENTRADA) = 4) AND (YEAR(os.DATA_ENTRADA) = 2026)
ORDER BY serv.data
